title: FLEX: ScenarioMIP CMIP7 Post-2100 Extensions Framework (software)
description: Code to extend the CMIP7 ScenarioMIP marker emissions scenarios from 2100 to 2500. FLEX is a standalone copy of the extension step of the CMIP7 emissions harmonization pipeline (iiasa/emissions_harmonization_historical, notebooks/5191_extension.py) and reproduces its output given the same inputs. Input scenario data are not included; see data/README.md.
